Even the low end of the sensitivity band clears +144's break-even, and shots depend little on the opposing goalie. The model-versus-market gap still deserves scrutiny.","model_case":"With projected ice time above 22 minutes, a shot mean near 2.75 supports the over. The weakness is that the projection is not far above the line: a modest drop in shot rate or minutes erodes most of the edge.","price_case":"This is a main 2.5 line at +144, and the model's minimum price is about +132. Four books suggest a lower chance, and the blend sits barely above break-even. The gap to the market is large for a shots prop and is unexplained.","context_case":"A defensive absence on his own side could support Montour's minutes. The Calgary goalie error matters less for shot volume. His own status is unverified.","blocking_checks":[]},"countercase":"Four books price the over near break-even, which implies they see a lower shot rate or less ice time. If Montour's power-play role or minutes come in below the projection, the thin cushion above 2.5 disappears.","open_checks":["Check Montour's power-play role and pairing.","Compare the price ladder across the other three books.","Reconfirm the +144 price and settlement rules."],"evidence":[{"source_id":"18404d065ffacc6cc491","excerpt":"Seattle Kraken: Ryan Lindgren (D); Upper Body; IR. Expected to be out until at least Nov 19","interpretation":"If Lindgren remains out, Montour could see expanded defensive minutes, which would support shot volume. Whether this is already in the ice-time projection is unclear.","kind":"injury","direction":"context","represented_in":"unknown"}]}]}
